title: F-Droid
desc: Installable catalogue of free and open-source software (FOSS) applications for Android.

title: Droid-ify
desc: Modern Material You client for F-Droid with fast repository syncing.

title: Aurora Store
desc: Open-source Google Play Store client providing anonymous downloads without Google Play Services.

title: APKMirror
desc: The most trusted safe archive for clean, original cryptographic APK binaries directly from developers.

title: Revanced Manager
desc: The official open-source patcher providing ad-free YouTube, SponsorBlock, background play, and UI customization.

title: NewPipe
desc: Lightweight streaming frontend for YouTube on Android without Google Play Services or account tracking.

title: AltStore
desc: Sideload IPA apps onto your un-jailbroken iOS device using your personal Apple ID.

title: SideStore
desc: Community fork of AltStore that refreshes sideloaded apps directly over on-device WireGuard without a PC.

title: TrollStore
desc: Permasigned IPA installer for supported iOS versions that bypasses the 7-day app certificate expiration.

title: iOS.cfw.guide
desc: The definitive step-by-step jailbreaking and rootless tweak guide for iPhone and iPad.

title: Shizuku
desc: Allows apps to use system APIs directly with ADB permissions without needing permanent root access.

title: Mihon
desc: The modern successor to Tachiyomi for reading online manga, webtoons, and comics on Android.
